_: Settings of scripts/preflight.mjs. timeoutSec: seconds one test may run (per file name, else default). smoke: tests --quick always runs (they must be in the release workflow's chain). budgets: the tests that carry a start-JS budget — output is a regex over the test's output whose first group is the size in KB, limit a regex over the test's source whose first group is the limit. parts: a test that runs as separate entries (own shard parts) with these arguments instead of once without; each part is timed and placed on its own (the test file is unchanged: uihunt.cjs en / ar select one language). Timings of the split live in scripts/preflight.timings.json.
